name: Quique Dacosta
lunchNoteEs: El mismo menú al mediodía · mié–dom

menus.name: Menu 'Octavo'
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; snacks in the garden, then the dining room; premium wine pairing €215; drinks with the snacks are extra; adapted for vegetarians on request

dressCode: Smart casual: cool and comfortable, with some elegance.
children: The meal isn't intended for children under 10. There are no high chairs or children's menus, but the kitchen can make something for a child, from €98.
duration: Two and a half to three hours.
bookingOpens: Online through CoverManager, or by phone. Guests arrive 1:30pm–2pm for lunch and 8:30pm–9pm for dinner; punctuality matters. For a same-day table, phone.
cancellation: Your card is authorised for €150 per guest (not charged). Cancelling or changing less than five days before, or not turning up, means the €150 is charged. Bookings can be passed to someone else.
groups: For more than 8 guests or events, email quiquedacosta@quiquedacosta.es. Separate bookings can't be joined into one table.
